rationale: The local LICENSE file at .references/frameworks/browser-use/LICENSE (22 lines) is the verbatim MIT License, copyright (c) 2024 Gregor Zunic. This is corroborated by pyproject.toml classifier 'License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License' (line 10) and by the remote LICENSE at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/browser-use/browser-use/main/LICENSE which matches. No NOTICE or COPYING files exist in the repository. MIT is an OSI-approved permissive license with no copyleft or proprietary constraints identified, so the repository passes as compatible. Dependency-level licenses (e.g. PostHog telemetry, browser-use-sdk, browser-use-core) were not audited and are out of scope for this repo-level determination.
